name: [HALLOWEEN🎃] Counter Blox
desc:
Take part in a 5v5 team based fire fight across a variety of maps spanning across the globe.

Earn in-match money by eliminating enemies and playing objectives, which you can use to buy new weapons, gear and grenades at the start of each round.

llm.loop: join 5v5 round -> buy weapons/gear with in-match money -> eliminate enemies and play objectives -> earn money for next round
llm.objectives: win rounds as a team by eliminating enemies and completing objectives
llm.progression: credits for cosmetic/weapon skins; in-match economy per round
llm.instructions: take part in 5v5 team firefights; earn in-match money by eliminating enemies and playing objectives, buy weapons, gear and grenades at round start
unique: Counter-Strike style tactical economy shooter on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: rendered masked terrorists and counter-terrorist soldiers with rifles, first-person phone/bomb view; character art
llm.complexity_notes: many detailed maps, gunplay system, round economy, weapon viewmodels and animations, skins
